solution_summary: Founded in Australia, Mentana is an AI SaaS platform designed to modernize global supply chain operations. Operating as an AI orchestration layer, the platform unifies real-time reasoning across legacy enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), and point-of-sale (POS) systems. By executing tasks autonomously, Mentana enables businesses to automate complex operational workflows, including demand forecasting, sales order processing, and physical-to-digital inventory reconciliation for global clients. The engineering team chose to execute the entire migration in-house, supported by Google Cloud's certification programs that helped engineers and data scientists build expertise across architecture and data science specialties.
